note: CoFID alcohol-free lager (UK average of 10 brands) and Ciqual alcohol-free beer (plain, and sweetened/flavoured) are the generic records; Heineken 0.0, Guinness 0.0, Carlsberg 0.0, Peroni 0.0 and Desperados Virgin 0.0 are exact can labels. UK cider by style from CoFID (dry, sweet, strong, low alcohol) and French cider (average, dry, sweet, half-dry, fruit-flavoured) from Ciqual; Strongbow and Somersby flavours are exact labels. The old US cider proxy is kept. ABV and sugar still vary by brand, so prefer the label when known.

CoFID white sparkling wine (about 11.5% ABV, not champagne), Ciqual sparkling white wine and champagne cover brut-style sparkling wine; Martini Prosecco and Asti Martini (sweet style) are exact labels. The old dry-white-wine proxy is kept but no longer needed.

CoFID liqueurs by strength (high strength 30-40% ABV such as Cointreau, Drambuie; low-medium 20-28% such as cherry brandy, Tia Maria; cream liqueurs) and Ciqual liqueur and blackcurrant liqueur now cover amaretto, limoncello, herbal and fruit liqueurs by strength band; Baileys, Kahlua and Malibu are exact labels. CoFID golden syrup (UK partially inverted cane syrup; 3 samples of one brand) covers it directly.

Ciqual dehydrated stock/broth (beef, poultry, vegetable) covers dry cubes and powder, so the vegetable stock cube is no longer missing. The old US bouillon records are kept. Ciqual aspartame tablets and aspartame powder (granulated, bulked) cover aspartame tabletop sweeteners. Still missing: sucralose and stevia sweeteners and other bulking agents, which need the pack label.
CoFID seeded bread (UK label data) plus Ciqual multigrain/seeded sandwich loaf, bread and country-style loaf. The old multi-grain estimate is kept but no longer needed.

CoFID crumpets, toasted (9 samples) covers crumpets as usually eaten. Still missing: untoasted crumpets as sold, so logging pack weight before toasting needs the pack label.
Ciqual brioche (average, plain prepacked, pure butter prepacked, plain from bakery) and brioche sandwich loaf cover plain brioche; filled brioches have their own Ciqual records.
Ciqual chocolate croissant (pain au chocolat) from the bakery and prepacked, plus the Starbucks pain au chocolat label.
CoFID Swiss-style muesli, no added sugar or salt (Jordans Natural and own brands) and Swiss-style muesli (Alpen and own brand), plus Ciqual unfortified muesli average.
CoFID Swiss-style muesli (Alpen-type with fruit and nuts) and Ciqual muesli with fruit, nuts and/or seeds (unfortified, no added sugar, fortified).

CoFID fortified cornflakes (15 samples, Kellogg's and own brands) and unfortified cornflakes, plus Ciqual plain cornflakes. Fortification still differs by brand, so use the pack label for micronutrients when known.
CoFID fortified bran flakes (15 samples, Kellogg's and own brands). Fortification and sugar still differ slightly by brand.
CoFID Weetabix-type wheat biscuits, fortified (Weetabix and own brands) and unfortified.

CoFID chilled carton soups: tomato, carrot and coriander, mushroom, broccoli and stilton (New Covent Garden and own brands). Other flavours still need the pot label; canned soups are under canned soup.
